patterns: Only one on-topic PYQ: APPSC G1 2024 asked the 'strategic objective' of asset monetisation - public asset owners using new structures (InvITs/REITs) with private capital; traps were private assets and indefinite leases.
Expect APPSC to ask conceptual one-liners on PPP models (HAM 40:60, BOT toll vs annuity, TOT, EPC) and disinvestment terms (strategic sale, OFS, DIPAM).
Committee -> year -> recommendation (Rangarajan 1993 49%, Ramakrishna 1996, Kelkar 2015 PPP) is a likely match-type item.
App MCQs are sound and mostly statement-based; several lean on 2025-26 current affairs (NMP 2.0, MoRTH 2026, AP PPP Policy-2026) not seen in PYQs.
